info.title: Gremion kernel — provisioning lifecycle events
info.description: First event class of the governance kernel (design 2026-06-08 §3.2/§4.4/§4.5, P0.4 deliverable). DESIGN-FORWARD: no broker runs yet; NATS JetStream lands in P1 scoped to the newsletter leaf. Envelope and subject grammar are binding; payload status enums are PROVISIONAL until reconciled with the merged P0.3a ledger semantics (provisioning_resources + provisioning_member_ops). JetStream mapping: Nats-Msg-Id = envelope.eventId (consumer dedup window + per-consumer idempotency-key table per design §4.4). tenant_id rides in BOTH subject and envelope (design §4.5) and is 'default' until Pillar 2 activates more tenants.

provisioningLifecycle.description: Subject grammar (NATS). aggregate: org-unit | member. event: requested | succeeded | failed | abandoned. Tenant-first so one poisoned tenant cannot head-of-line-block others (design §5).

tenantId.description: Tenant slug; 'default' until Pillar 2 multi-tenancy activates.

publishProvisioningLifecycle.summary: Kernel publishes provisioning state transitions from the ledger-as-outbox (P0.3) via the BrokerPort (P0.5; wired in P1).

consumeProvisioningLifecycle.summary: Future consumers (first: idempotent audit consumer, P1). At-least-once delivery; consumers MUST dedupe on eventId.
